caption: The drawing depicts three objects arranged in a triangular composition against a cream-colored background. Each object consists of a straight, vertical pin with a circular or oval element at the top. The central object shows a pin with a pink-colored circular top that has small rectangular segments around its circumference; the stick extends vertically from the bottom of the circle. To the left, there is a similar pin with a circle at its head, but its border is grayish-blue and it appears less segmented than the central one. On the right, the third object is shown in profile; its circular pink top is seen from the side, appearing as a narrow oval or line, and the golden pin extends downward. The drawing includes a small signature in the lower left corner reading “J. Wilton, Klamien.” No other objects or decorative elements are present on the mostly empty background.
title: Jewelry
